scenes.label: Horse owner news
scenes.vo: New rules for horse owners are on the way. Here's what's changing.

scenes: Where your horse lives, on record.
Owners will record where each horse is normally kept on the Central Equine Database, and update it if that changes for more than 30 days.

scenes.vo: One. You'll record where your horse normally lives on the Central Equine Database, and update it if that changes for more than thirty days.

scenes: Places where horses are kept, including private homes, will need to be registered or approved.

scenes.vo: Two. Wherever horses are kept, even at home, will need to be registered or approved.

scenes: It's part of the new UK-EU agreement, subject to approval. Defra says you don't need to change anything now.

scenes.vo: Three. It's part of the new UK and EU deal, due from March twenty twenty-eight. Defra says you don't need to change anything yet.

scenes: Good idea, or just more paperwork?
